★Request
Costume: Summer Tracksuit Standard (*Dry)
Fade in running
Font: Normal

A ton of water, a fire striker...
Oh, and even an edible wild plants field guide!
Huh? Oh, could it be you're super hungry?
I'm so happy you enjoyed it~.
I'm so glad I got you to be my Trainer!

Still... Trainer, that's a huge load of luggage!
What did you bring all of that for?
I made up my mind to find a chance to treat her to a meal next time.

You always eat with such a big smile on your face, Trainer,
so it makes me super happy too~.

It's okay! We're not just having hot pot, you know.
We've got skewers, and I'll make grilled stuff too!

Since I had a wild plant field guide on hand,
I decided to look around for some ingredients.

Ahaha! That's right.
You were collapsed right over here, Trainer!

Everything tasted amazing, and despite the enormous spread,
my chopsticks never stopped—I polished off every single bite.

Whenever you're hungry, just let me know~.
I'll make a whole bunch more for you!

I was so startled back then~.
I didn't know what I was gonna do if you didn't wake up.

Having obtained permission from the fisheries cooperative Hishi Akebono was on good terms with,
we arrived at—that uninhabited island.

They said we could catch seafood too!
Trainer, keep watch so the birds don't snatch anything, okay?

Oh, take it easy and get some rest, Trainer!
You must be tired, right? Keeping watch takes a lot out of you~.

I spotted some mushrooms, but even with a guide, an amateur shouldn't take chances.
It was disappointing, but best to give up on those.
Traineeer! Sorry to keep you waiting!

Let's put that luggage down for now and... get started!
Time to gather some yummy, yummy kelp~!
Traineeer! Traineeer!!
Ahaha, you're exaggerating~.
That being said, I felt bad just spacing out and doing nothing.

I'll have it ready in a jiffy,
so just wait a little bit~!

I wonder if the Goddess was as big as me, though?
If someone knows, I'll have to ask them next time~.

Just wait a tiny bit~.
Once you eat this, you'll be full of energy!

I brought an earthenware pot today~.
It's gonna turn out super delicious~!

Hishi Akebono began her preparations with practiced skill.
It didn't look like there was anything I could help with here.

Found you! Thank goodness~.
What happened? Did you get lost?

Mmm, feels so good!
It's the perfect day for gathering kelp!

I caught some giant shellfish and fish~!
I'm gonna whip up lunch with these right now~!

Enough food to feed a sumo stable was laid out before me.
Fish and vegetable skewers... and even rice to finish off the hot pot.

Hishi Akebono had a satisfied smile on her face. She seemed happy just
serving the food, but I still wanted to repay her somehow.
Did you get your fill?

After seeing off Hishi Akebono as she went to gather kelp and seafood,
I spent two hours watching the luggage in the shade—
...I searched for a while, but couldn't find anything viable.
